programme.desc: Dermot Bannon helps a family to transform their 70s bungalow outside Tipperary into a modern family home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: This week Dermot goes to Cork to work with a family spanning three generations - who all have different ideas on how to improve their home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dermot Bannon tries to turn a dilapidated, woodworm infested 1930s cottage into a starter home for a Finglas family.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: This week Dermot tackles a large Victorian terraced house in the highly sought-after Dublin suburb of Donnybrook.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: The first in the season will see Catherine Bennett and her youngest daughter Sarah Jane keen to downsize from their huge 13-bedroomed house in Mullingar. They're planning to move down the road, where they also own a 3-bed bungalow that's been uninhabited for the last nine years.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dermot faces a unique challenge in Clane, Co. Kildare.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Architect Dermot Bannon helps Senator Katherine Zappone and Dr Ann Louise Gilligan renovate a dilapidated hunting lodge in Brittas, Dublin.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Desperate for more space, a couple with two young daughters, who have long since outgrown their tiny cottage in Killawalla outside Westport, engage Dermot to help.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: New Yorker Ursula and accountant Jimmy from Ennis enlist Dermot's help with their colossal house in Firhouse, Dublin

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Clare Heenan and Rory Kelly live in a compact 1950's bungalow in the south Dublin suburb of Stillorgan. Long time renters, the couple struggled for years to afford this house. It's their first home but with a series of small, disjointed rooms and a damp, grotty extension - it's far from ideal...

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the ten years since they first met Avril and Andrew Wilson-Rankin have been dreaming of owning their own home. Now they've bought a property in Dun Laoghaire south county Dublin but it's as far from being a home, or even a house, as you could imagine.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Jean Robinson and Daithi Elliffe have bought themselves what they hope will be an ideal family home in a unique location - a listed 19th century former schoolhouse at Kilternan with spectacular views of the Dublin mountains, but all is not as it appears.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Struggling with a tight schedule, a limited budget and the traditionalist taste of his clients, can Dermot balance their love of classic farmhouse design with his own vision of clean urban functionality?

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: This week, Dermot wants to create a wheelchair friendly house in Malahide that's also a welcoming family home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Sally-Ann, her husband Trevor, and their four children live in Sally-Ann's childhood home - a huge, distinctive 1970s architect-designed home outside Mullingar in Westmeath that they've dreamed of rennovating for years.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Since they married two years ago, Paul and Sabina Horgan have become the proud parents of baby Mia and the owners of a property on the North Dublin coast: Lismara - a dilapidated 1940s cottage in Portmarnock in an extremely poor condition.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: GP, writer and budding musician Dr Pat Harrold, his wife Marita, a physiotherapist, and their four kids returned to Pat's home town of Nenagh 10 years ago and they have been looking for a place to call home ever since.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Leonard and Caroline live in house once owned by Leonard's grandparents in the south Dublin suburb of Dundrum - a 1960s three-bed semi that hasn't changed at all since the couple bought it two years ago.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At the village of Puckaun in north Tipperary, teachers Darragh Egan, his partner Sarah Lovett and their three month old son Donagh are moving home. What could be simpler or more straightforward? Well, as it turns out, quite a lot. Home is the 1960s bungalow where Darragh grew up - built on the site of the old village school by his late father Jim and currently occupied by his 70 year old mother.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Airline pilot Ian Callaghan has bought a 1930s Victorian house in his hometown of Drogheda, County Louth, which he and his girlfriend Claire Moore are keen to call home. Though full of charm and period features, the house is in dire need of renovation. Enter: architect Dermot Bannon with an innovative plan to retain the building's century-old ambience while adding a radical modern extension.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Last year, Aoife from Sutton and her wife Mel from New Zealand bought themselves a three bed semi in Baldoyle north Dublin - a tiny house in a spectacular bayside location. With incredible, unobstructed views of the sea and Portmarnock golf course, they've been hoping to renovate the house to suit its superb location ever since.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: This week Dermot is in Maynooth. Seven years ago, George and Sinead Mullis fell in love in with the Coach house - an 1850s building on half an acre of the historic former Carton Estate in Maynooth. In 2014, they bought the place for just half of its former asking price and moved in with their two year old son Daniel. But what seemed like their dream home soon turned out to be anything but.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: A special edition of the show where Dermot revisits three of his favourite builds from earlier series: the Longford publicans he convinced the embrace the void, a couple moving home from California to Bishopstown and 14 year old Michael's wheelchair accessible semi-d in Malahide.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Robbie and Julie from Darndale in North Dublin have saved for over 20 years to buy the house of their dreams - a 1940s cottage in the picturesque north Dublin suburb of Malahide. With a budget of 180K, Dermot's clients plan to gut the cottage, doubling its size with a spacious new two-storey extension to the rear, but the remediation costs are high.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Farmer and Boatbuilder Enda and his wife Mags live on a 55 acre Brussel Sprout farm at Balheary near Swords in North Dublin. After three decades of life in the country, they're moving back to Enda's home town - the picturesque seaside village of Rush. Their new home, formerly owned by Enda's aunt is an old fisherman's house near the harbour.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Moate in County Westmeath, is a place where football is part sport, part religion. On an overgrown plot on the outskirts of town lies the abandoned future home of county GAA All Star Dessie Dolan, his wife Kelly and their 3-year-old son Nathan. They have bought themselves a dilapidated cottage on a hopelessly exposed site in the village.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At Sutton in North Dublin, Dermot extends a 1960s suburban house, changing a beloved childhood home into a sumptuous new one for Hannah, James and their twin sons. To give the couple the 'wow factor' they've asked for, Dermot designs a large L-shaped extension at the rear of the house with a soaring mezzanine level.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Having rented a house in Navan for the last two years, teacher Celine and sound engineer Dave are excited at the prospect of moving to a farmhouse once owned by her grandparents at Kildalkey village in County Meath where Celine grew up. The couple will be the fourth generation to live there and retaining the charm and character of the old place is a major concern for the whole family.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the three years since newlyweds Rosie and Keith bought their five-bed house in Templeogue, Dublin 6, they haven't changed a thing. From the dark, cold interiors to the cavity block, flat roofed extension, this house is a relic of 1970s design, with décor to match. Keen to create a unique take on the rather unimaginative suburban semi, Dermot designs a radical, steep-roofed extension...

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Country and Irish legend Daniel O'Donnell and his wife Majella share a large four bed detached home in Kincasslagh West Donegal. Unlike Daniel, who's fairly happy with the place, Majella is keen to upgrade and reconfigure the interior. With her husband on tour, she's determined to get the very best from her architect.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Nine years ago, Susie and Dave bought their dream home on the outskirts of Fermoy in Cork - a 170 year old three storey mansion that Susie has admired since she was a teenager. The house however, has begun to show its age and Susie and Dave want to extend and upgrade to create the ultimate family home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: IT manager Christine has bought herself a red brick terraced house in Clontarf, North Dublin. Christine has big plans for the place but as Dermot quickly discovers, they're far bigger than her 130K budget will allow. And despite his best efforts, Dermot is unable to convince Christine to modify her 25 page wish list.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At the seaside village of Portrane in North Dublin, Dermot creates a workable home for three generations of the one family under the watchful, budget-conscious eyes of two sisters.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Recently returned to Ireland after 12 years in London, new parents website designer Cliona and IT manager Micheal have already spent 30 grand renovating a 1950s semi-D at Killester in North Dublin in their own distinctive, industrial style.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dairy farmer Padraig and schoolteacher Katie are hoping to create their 'forever' home by renovating a century-old farmhouse on a half acre of land recently inherited from Padraig's uncle. But delivering this dream won't be easy for their architect. Dermot's problems begin when he presents his initial design and it Katie announces that she has no time for 'open plan' living.

programme.title: Room to Improve

programme.title: Hard Boiled
programme.desc: Laittoman aselastin ratsia päättyy verilöylyyn, mikä pakottaa väkivaltaisen poliisin ja salaisen soluttautujan yhteistyöhön triadien imperiumin jahtaamisessa. John Woon ikonisimmassa ja räjähtävimmässä elokuvassa Hard Boiled nähdään kivenkovaa gangsteritoimintaa, jossa jokainen tulitaistelu on näyte tarkkuudesta ja hulluudesta. Luodit lentävät ja ruumiit kaatuvat, kun kukaan ei enää tiedä, keneen voi luottaa.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Toiminnantäyteisessä sci-fi -trillerissä ryhmä nuoria amerikkalaisia on vierailulla Moskovassa, kun muukalaislaji hyökkää kaupunkiin ja syöksee heidät keskelle epätoivoista selviytymistaistelua. Näkymättömät, puhtaasta energiasta koostuvat olennot muuttavat säälittä kohtaamansa ihmiset tuhkaksi pelkällä kosketuksellaan.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3
programme.desc: Eletään 1600-luvun alkua feodaaliajan Japanissa, ja ratsain kulkeva mies jää vangiksi taistelussaan samurairyhmää vastaan. Vajaat 400 vuotta myöhemmin toimittaja April O’Neil hankkii kirpputorilta lahjoja kilpikonnaystävilleen. Tavarat ovat enimmäkseen harmittomia, mutta Tikku-mentori saa vanhan japanilaisen valtikan. Valtikka kätkee sisälleen taikavoimia, ja yhtäkkiä sankarimme löytävät itsensä samuraiden Japanista, jossa he päätyvät keskelle kilpailevien lääninherrojen sotaa.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: "Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman, jolle vanhemmat rouvat jalokivineen ovat helppoja saaliita. Pian kuitenkin panokset pelissä muuttuvat kovemmiksi, kun Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun. Mafian ollessa valmis raivaamaan todistajat hengiltä tylyn armottomalla tyylillään, on Parkerin suojeltava Tonya ja varmistettava tämän pääsy elossa todistamaan. Kytän ja varkaan epätavallinen taistelupari saa aikaa valtaisaa tuhoa alamaailman keskuudessa..."

programme.title: Senkka nenästä pojat!
programme.desc: Järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vedonlyöjät, korttihait ja huijarit piinaavat toimillaan Miamia, ja poliisin johto on päättänyt ottaa kovat keinot käyttöön ja puhdistaa kaupungin. Mutta koska poliisin omat resurssit eivät riitä toivottuun lopputulokseen, värvätään veljekset, Johnny ja Charlie Flippo, likaisen työn hommaan...Vaikka Johnny on laivaston upseeri ja Charlie vain rekkakuski, on heidän urbaanit selviytymiskykynsä ja kontaktit legendaariset. Veljekset sukeltavat alamaailman kuvioihin kuin kalat veteen, ja pistävät taidoillaan sekä nyrkeillään rikollisten päät sekaisin! Mutta Johnny ja Charlie eivät ole kuvioissa mukana hyvää hyvyyttään - täytyyhän omista eduista pitää myös kiinni.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa ja Rose ovat 17-vuotiaita tyttöjä, jotka käyvät lukiota monien muiden 17-vuotiaiden tapaan. He eroavat muista siten, että Lissa juo verta ja heidän lukionsa on salainen sisäoppilaitos rauhantahtoisille Moroi-vampyyreille ja heidän suojelijoilleen! Rose on yksi suojelijoista ja puolustaa Lissaa hinnalla millä hyvänsä. Epäonnistuneen pakoyrityksen jälkeen tytöt päätyvät kaikkein vaarallisimpaan paikkaan: vampyyriakatemiaan!

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa! Jo aamiainen ja koulumaksujen hoitaminen ovat rankkoja tehtäviä, mutta kun yksi lapsista suututtaa venäläisen terroristin, viikonloppu saa aivan uudenlaisen käänteen.Jackie Chaniin ei väsy koskaan eikä Jackie Chan ole koskaan liian vanha näyttämään taistelulajiosaamistaan tai tekemään vaarallisia stuntteja, sillä jälleen kerran hänellä on vastassaan vihollisia: pieniä lapsukaisia!

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Keskiajan historia kirjoitetaan uudelleen, kun Jamal Walker putoaa Medieval World -teemapuiston vallihautaan ja huomaa siirtyneensä ajassa taaksepäin.

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Hurmaava Jon on epäonnistunut elämässään ja päättää lähteä tavoittelemaan menetettyä rakkautta. Autoekspertti Luke pakenee menneisyyttään. Yhdessä hampurilaispaikassa työskentelevän vegaaniaktivisti Keiran kanssa he rikkovat normeja ja päätyvät ajamaan “lainatulla” keltaisella Mini Cooperilla Uuden-Seelannin poikki, poliisi ja media perässään.

programme.title: Banaanipojat hula-hula saarella
programme.desc: Huoletonta elämää viettävä onnenonkija Alan saa käsiinsä aarrekartan, josta selviää japanilaisten sotajoukkojen toisen maailmansodan aikana kätkemän rahasaaliin sijainti. Rahojen löytäminen on kuitenkin helpommin sanottu kuin tehty. Aarre sijaitsee kaukaisella trooppisella autiosaarella ja lisäksi kartan perässä ovat kaupungin gangsterit.Päästäkseen roistoja pakoon ja aarretta etsimään, piiloutuu Alan rauhaa rakastavan Charlien veneeseen. Monen mutkan ja koitoksen jälkeen Alan ja Charlie pääsevät saarelle, ainoastaan huomatakseen ettei se olekaan asumaton.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Tarina keskittyy neljään ei-niin-nuoreen orpoon: yhden heistä on kasvattanut Louvren kuraattori; toinen on pakolainen meksikolaisesta vapaapainista; kolmas äskettäinen hänen lentokoneessaan olleiden käärmeiden uhri; ja neljäs "normaali" asukas mutantti "X" -yhteisöstä. Onneton kvartetti vierailee suklaatehtaalla, jossa he törmäävät lumottuun vaatekaappiin, joka kuljettaa heidät Gnarnian maahan (hiljaisella ”G”: llä). Siellä he kohtaavat prameilevan merirosvokapteenin ja vilpittömät taikuuden opiskelijat – ja yhdistävät voimansa muun muassa viisaan, mutta kiimaisen leijonan kanssa voittaakseen Gnarnian ”Pahan Valkoisen Nartun”.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Kuolettavista vammoistaan parannettu Elektra (Jennifer Garner) elää tappamiselle maailman vaarallisimpana palkkamurhaajana. Uusin sopimus pakottaa hänet kuitenkin tekemään ratkaisun, jonka seuraukset johtavat äärimmäiseen hyvän ja pahan taisteluun.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Nuorenparin (Ryan Phillippe ja Mena Suvari) täytyy paeta lähetyssaarnaaja-asemaltaan Kalaharin autiomaassa, kun sotilaallinen äärijärjestö uhkaa heitä. Kun he pääsevät rähjäisen, korruptoituneen salakuljettajan (Emile Hirsch) pienkoneen kyytiin, heidän pääsynsä turvaan on käsien ulottuvilla. Mutta kun koneesta katoavat virrat ja se tippuu, yhä suurempi uhka odottaa: he ovat keskellä ihmisiä syövien villieläinten - leijonien, leopardien ja hyeenojen - suojelualuetta. Tämä loukkaantuneiden ja peloissaan olevien matkustajien sekalainen ryhmä joutuu taistelemaan henkensä edestä siellä missä vain vahvimmat selviävät.

programme.title: Iron Monkey
programme.desc: Naamiosankari Iron Monkey hiippailee öisin ryöstelemässä korruptoituneita virkamiehiä, ja päivisin hän tarjoaa ilmaista sairaanhoitoa köyhille. Uuden lääkärin tulo kaupunkiin aiheuttaa aluksi kilpailua, mutta yhteinen vihollinen yhdistääkin lääkärit ja taistelijat.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: Raivokkaassa toisen maailmansodan Saipanin taistelussa kersantti Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) vartioi – ja ystävystyy – Ben Yahzeen (Adam Beach) kanssa, nuoren navajon, joka on koulutettu käyttämään ainoaa sodanaikaista koodia, jota vihollinen ei koskaan murtautunut... Navajo-koodia. Mutta jos Yahzee joutuu vihollisen käsiin, kuinka pitkälle Enders on valmis menemään pelastaakseen armeijan voimakkaimman salaisuuden? John Woo ohjaa tämän toimintapitoisen eeppisen elokuvan, joka on saanut innoituksensa navajosotilaiden todellisesta tarinasta, joiden rohkeus ja uhraukset auttoivat voittamaan sodan Tyynellämerellä.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Senkka nenästä pojat!
programme.desc: Järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vedonlyöjät, korttihait ja huijarit piinaavat toimillaan Miamia, ja poliisin johto on päättänyt ottaa kovat keinot käyttöön ja puhdistaa kaupungin. programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Power Rangers on viiden tavallisen lukiolaisen tarina. He löytävät ikivanhan avaruusaluksen ja huomaavat yhtäkkiä saaneensa yliluonnolliset voimat. Viisikko äkkää, että muukalaiset aikovat tuhota heidän pienen kotikaupunkinsa Angel Groven ja siinä samassa koko maailman, joten heidän on ryhdyttävä maailmanpelastajiksi.

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthyn tähdittämä räävittömän hillitön komedia Elokuva sijoittuu Los Angelesin laitamille, jossa nuket ja ihmiset elävät rinta rinnan. Kaksi erimielistä etsivää, toinen ihminen, toinen nukke, joutuvat työskentelemään yhdessä selvittääkseen kuka murhaa julmasti suositun The Happytime Gang -nukkeshow’n entisiä tähtiä.

programme.title: Banaanipojat hula-hula saarella
programme.desc: Huoletonta elämää viettävä onnenonkija Alan saa käsiinsä aarrekartan, josta selviää japanilaisten sotajoukkojen toisen maailmansodan aikana kätkemän rahasaaliin sijainti. Rahojen löytäminen on kuitenkin helpommin sanottu kuin tehty. Aarre sijaitsee kaukaisella trooppisella autiosaarella ja lisäksi kartan perässä ovat kaupungin gangsterit.Päästäkseen roistoja pakoon ja aarretta etsimään, piiloutuu Alan rauhaa rakastavan Charlien veneeseen. Monen mutkan ja koitoksen jälkeen Alan ja Charlie pääsevät saarelle, ainoastaan huomatakseen ettei se olekaan asumaton.

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen. Hän saa yliluonnolliset supervoimat, ja pian Miamin rikoskäyrät ovat rajussa laskussa. Vastavetona päättävät kaupungin päärikolliset ratkaista ongelman nimeltä Dave Speed hinnalla ja keinolla millä hyvänsä... Superkytän voimat joutuvat kerta toisensa jälkeen todelliselle koetukselle, mutta ei hätää, niin kauan kuin hän ei näe mitään punaista. Kyseinen väri on Davelle kuin kryptoniitti Teräsmiehelle...

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Tutkimusmatkailija Dirk Pitt ja muut lähtevät kaikkien aikojen seikkailulle heidän etsiessään Länsi-Afrikasta panssaroitua taistelulaivaa, jolla on mukanaan salainen lasti.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa ja Rose ovat 17-vuotiaita tyttöjä, jotka käyvät lukiota monien muiden 17-vuotiaiden tapaan. He eroavat muista siten, että Lissa juo verta ja heidän lukionsa on salainen sisäoppilaitos rauhantahtoisille Moroi-vampyyreille ja heidän suojelijoilleen! Rose on yksi suojelijoista ja puolustaa Lissaa hinnalla millä hyvänsä. Epäonnistuneen pakoyrityksen jälkeen tytöt päätyvät kaikkein vaarallisimpaan paikkaan: vampyyriakatemiaan!

programme.title: Ullakkojengi (Aliens in the Attic)
programme.desc: Vihdoinkin kesäloma – mutta Pearsonin lapset ovat jumissa tylsällä mökillä. Kunnes ärhäkät pienet avaruusoliot laskeutuvat katolle suunnitellen mökin JA maailman valloitusta, ja nuorten on yhdistettävä voimansa ja videopelitaitonsa pelastaakseen maailman!

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splinter; rotta sensei; aistii, että hänen neljä teini-ikäistä kilpikonnaopettajaansa ovat eronneet ja heidän on luotava side voittaakseen muinaisen hirviön.

programme.title: Haven
programme.desc: Cayman-saaret…palmuja, hiekkaa, rantapupuja ja aurinkoleijonia kristallinkirkkaan meren äärellä. Mutta lentoliikenne tuo saarille perusturistin lisäksi toisenlaistakin väkeä. Kuten FBI:n etsimiä veropakolaisia, joiden omaisuus on teipattu keskikehon ympärille tuhteina setelinippuina. Auringon laskiessa saarilla käydään monenlaista bisnestä, joista osa ei kestä päivänvaloa. Saarilla riittää bileitä, seksiä ja jääkylmiä drinkkejä ja aina löytyy joku, joka erottelee amatöörit ammattilaisista kovalla kädellä.

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: Vuoteen 1903 sijoittuva ihmisjahtidraama Jäljittäjä alkaa kun Arjan (Ray Winstone), Etelä-Afrikan buurisodista selviytynyt sissi, saapuu Uuden-Seelannin siirtokuntaan ja hänelle luvataan palkkio Kereaman (Temuera Morrison), sotilaan tappamisesta syytetyn maori merimiehen, kiinniottamisesta. Tehtävä, jonka pitäisi olla helppo mestarijäljittäjä Arjanille muuttuu mukaansatempaavaksi ja vaaralliseksi kissa ja hiiri -leikiksi Kereaman, joka vannoo koko ajan viattomuuttaan, paetessa ja jäädessä kiinni yhä uudestaan. Yliotteen vaihtuessa vuoronperään mieheltä toiselle, Arjan ja Kereama alkavat tutustumaan toisiinsa – ja lopulta kunnioittamaan toisiaan.

programme.title: Van Veeteren: Pääsky, kissa, ruusu, kuolema
programme.desc: Van Veeteren –elokuvat perustuvat Håkan Nesserin menestysromaaneihin. Tapahtumat sijoittuvat fiktiiviseen Pohjois-Euroopan kaupunkiin nimeltä Maardam, ja seuraavat eläkkeelle jääneen komisario Van Veeterenin (Sven Wollter) ja hänen suojattiensa – rikosetsivien Münster (Thomas Hanzon) ja Moreno (Eva Rexed) - edesottamuksia. Münster löytää nuoren naisen kotoaan murhattuna ja onnistuu yllättämään murhaajan, joka on vielä asunnossa. Murhaaja onnistuu kuitenkin pakenemaan, mutta jättää jälkeensä erikoisen kirjan, joka sisältää terveiset syylliseltä.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banaani Joen elämä on yhtä auringonpaistetta. Lokoisaa iloista oloa, ilman stressiä eteläisellä paratiisisaarella, kunnes... Joen asuinkylä on jäämässä modernin business-kulttuurin jalkoihin. Pian paikkaa pyörittävät byrokraatit ja jengit, pykälineen ja paheineen. Korruptio ja sääntöviidakko alkavat rehottaa paratiisissa, ja huoleton vapauden aurinko on jäämässä pahasti pyrkyreiden ja rahastajien varjoon. Joe ei lainkaan pidä siitä mitä on tapahtumassa, eikä ole valmis luopumaan idyllisestä paratiisistaan ilman taistelua. On aika takoa nyrkein joidenkin päähän järkeä, ja näyttää mistä kuuluu ja kuka käskee!

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to Rovaniemi, where she visits a husky farm and finds out about about breeding and raising huskies.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. Catriona realizes this when she roams around the cobblestone streets of the city. With every monument she visits, she finds herself transported to a different era, right from Perperikon fort, which narrate stories of the Byzantine empire, to Boyana church, which is home to some of the earliest examples of medieval artwork.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Great World Hotels, Four Seasons 1(Eng)
programme.desc: From lazing in hammocks by the beach to sipping drinks on a private yacht, Kim realizes that Maldives is the perfect destination to unwind in style.

programme.desc: From trying dishes like Stroopwafel and Palat Stoofvlees to visiting the Erasmus bridge, cube houses and wall painting on the streets, Alex explores Rotterdam.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Since medieval times Aberdeenshire and its northwestern neighbour Moray have been the richest and most fertile regions of the Highlands. Aberdeenshire is famed for its Aberdeen Angus beef cattle, its many fine castles and the prosperous 'granite city' of Aberdeen.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: Explore Majdanpek with our host as the city brings the viewers closer to the treasures strewn across the Serbian countryside.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Boarding Pass Levi, Finland
programme.desc: Levi is Finland's largest and fastest-growing ski destination. Emeline is here, to find out the exciting activities that Levi offers, in summer.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: With snow-capped peaks rising over primeval forests and traditional villages, Paro is like an Oriental Switzerland. On a visit to Paro, Radhika explores famous monasteries such as the Rinpung Dzong and Takstang Monastery, and learns the history and legends associated with them. Along the way, she finds out the secrets to the quintessential Bhutanese peace and contentment.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Great World Hotels, Four Seasons 2(Eng)
programme.desc: An invigorating spa treatment, a cooking lesson, a snorkeling session – Kim has experiences in the Maldives that leave her completely rejuvenated.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Food Fact Fun Utrecht, Netherlands
programme.desc: From trying Orange zest beer and traditional Dutch dishes to exploring St.Martin's Cathedral, Dom Tower and enjoying go karting and stand up paddle boat ride, watch Alex enjoy his trip in Utrecht.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: In the enchanting landscapes of Inverness, Robbie’s journey takes a whimsical turn: from eccentric to downright magical.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Nis,one of the oldest cities in Europe.She visits a concentration camp and later paraglides to end by watching a musical performance.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Boarding Pass Ruka Kuusamo, Finland
programme.desc: Emeline goes to Ruka-Kuusamo, where she tries river rafting. She also meets a reindeer herder,who tells her about the unique ways of herding reindeer.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Actress and travel enthusiast, Radhika Bangia explores the enigma that is Bhutan, when she visits Thimpu, the capital city with no traffic lights and no skyscrapers invading the skyline. Here, she checks out significant sights such as the Tibetan-style National Memorial Chorten, the National Library and the Folk Heritage Museum in order to understand more about the beliefs, history, architecture and cuisine of Bhutan.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 World Heritage Ancient Temples of Egypt, Egypt (ENG)
programme.desc: Explore the ancient heritage sites of Abu Simbel, the Philae complex of Nubia and the Hatshepsut Temple to unravel the mystical stories behind the ancient temples of Egypt.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Food Fact Fun Gouda, Netherlands
programme.desc: Alex tries traditional Dutch food in Leiden, learns about Dutch history at Prinsenhof Museum, visits a Gothic church, a local cheese market and Delftware factory at Gouda.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 10 Days Scotland Isle Of Skye (ENG)
programme.desc: The grand finale of Robbie’s wild homecoming unfolds amidst the rugged beauty of the Isle of Skye.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.sub-title: S01 : E31 Backpack Resavsk Pecina, Serbia
programme.desc: Continue exploring Serbia with Heather as she visits the Manasija monastery, Resavska caves, ending with a joyride onboard Eight of Sargan rail line.

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 With Love From Mauritius Ep 1
programme.desc: Krisann and Nathan’s vacation in Mauritius begins in Le Morne, where an unexpected adventure awaits the latter.

programme.title: Xplore Bhutan
programme.desc: Known as Druk Yul or the “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, Bhutan is the country of mountains, monasteries and mystery. Radhika Bangia finds this to be true when she visits Punakha, the former capital of Bhutan, where she marvels at the architecture of Punakha Dzong and gets to know the story behind the two rivers, Mo Chhu and Po Chhu. She also explores the sacred temples and Mebar Tsho lake of Bumthang, the religious heart of Bhutan, and gets to know the local legends.

programme.title: World Spas
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 World Spas Kempenki, Jordan (ENG)
programme.desc: Jamie Srubis tries out spa treatments, which are inspired by the Dead Sea and the desert surroundings at Hotel Kempinski Ishtar in Jordan.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Food Fact Fun Dubai 1
programme.desc: After Burj Khalifa, Alex has a traditional Emirati platter, visits the gold market and skiing rink, and goes for a camel safari and camping.

programme.title: City break
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 City Breaks Innsbruck, Austria
programme.desc: Nestled in the mighty Alps, tour the Austrian city of Innsbruck with Sabrina and explore a town that’s alpine-urban yet traditional in nature.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: In her final leg of journey, Heather visits the Uvac canyon, tries locally prepared pie, ending with Kopaonik National Park and Jelovarnik waterfalls.

programme.title: With Love From Mauritius
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 With Love From Mauritius Ep 2
programme.desc: On an island-hopping adventure in Mauritius, Krisann and Nathan find out that time works differently on these islands.

programme.title: XP Guide
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 XP Guide Copenhagen, Denmark
programme.desc: A homely place where the aroma of freshly baked bread greets you as people smoothly glide along on their bicycles. Welcome to Copenhagen.

programme.title: Unwind
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Unwind Hotel Oriole, Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Indeya explores the Cinnamon plantations, tries a local dish and witnesses a traditional dance performance.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Food Fact Fun Dubai 2
programme.desc: Alex has varied experiences in Dubai like trying Lebanese cheese bread, visiting a coffee museum, going to IMG Worlds of Adventure and more.

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Food Fact Fun Amsterdam, Netherlands
programme.desc: In Amsterdam, Alex tries Bitterballen, cannabis cake and visits Heineken Experience brewery. He explores Zaanse Schans village with windmills and Coster Diamonds, the oldest diamond polishing factory.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s journey to reconnect with his Scottish roots begins in Edinburgh, the stunning capital city perched on extinct volcanoes. Navigating the twists of the Royal Mile, strutting around the majestic Edinburgh castle and learning to sip scotch like a true Scotsman, he feels a tad closer to his heritage. The real fun kicks in, however, when he stumbles onto a rather flamboyant way to unleash his inner Highlander.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

It is among these magnificent peaks that Zaira found peace within herself and harmony with her surroundings. Now, eager to help others heal, she is the leader of a trekking initiative that doubles as a support group for other women who are victims of sexual aggression.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Ile (Argentina)

In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - David Jeannerot
programme.desc: David Jeannerot left the world of fashion and abandoned his career as artistic director to become a plant. An exceptional florist who wishes to give back all its place to nature in the city.David had a dream life. He traveled around the world for major ready-to-wear brands. But under the appearance David was actually very isolated. To give meaning to his life, and to go in the direction of his personal convictions, he decides to become a plantist. He arranges corners of greenery on the smallest window sill with the aim of bringing nature to the city, and to make Paris greener.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Agostina (Argentina)
programme.desc: When Agostina’s mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, she began seeking out soft natural fabrics that would not irritate her mother’s sensitive skin. She found it almost impossible to find the right materials, so she decided to make her own. Research led her to bamboo fibers and she realised she could make a positive impact on the environment, while developing sustainable and ethical fashion.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Solenn (Nantes)
programme.desc: A former school teacher reinvents herself when she discovers a passion for sharing other women’s stories. Always inspired by the journeys of strong women, Solenn began a blog to celebrate the women in her community. Solenn’s energy and passion fueled a dream of starting her own magazine. Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign, this dream blossomed into a professional career in journalism and she launched a print mook (magazine & book) called Etonnantes. Etonnantes features interviews of women of all backgrounds, celebrating their diversity and success in each field.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Sophie (Nantes)
programme.desc: Always an artist at heart, Sophie grew up in the countryside amongst nature and farm animals. Her love for creating art while respecting nature turned into a drive to seek out sustainable vegetable dyes.Today, her artwork and craft are intertwined as she makes beautiful prints and motifs that she colours with natural dyes, prepared from handpicked variety of flowers and plants that turn into stunning creations.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The Bordeaux country
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Poultry on the menu
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Poultry on the menu
programme.desc: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew. Julie will then head back up towards the center to discover an amazing fly maker who uses rooster feathers!

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Annabelle Higgins and Valérie Sirois
programme.desc: They are beautiful sisters, they are passionate about nature and they have a very strong common point: entrepreneurship. After years of evolution in consumer sectors, discover Annabelle and Valérie who knew how to listen to their passion to create a fitness and surf club (for Annabelle) and a zero waste grocery store (for Valérie).

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Véronick Desmarais
programme.desc: The everyday work is not always easy and it is sometimes difficult to get by. If there is one thing that Véronick has learned from her experience and those around her, it is because she is able to surpass that and to embark on her dreams and plans to become a massage therapist. You will believe in your abilities too.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Violaine Courtois
programme.desc: Everything started from the dream of her parents, she becomes a veterinarian. In her career that she launched backwards, Violaine will meet people who will take her to a different path of life. The chance will be at the rendezvous but it is especially the courage to resume studies and create his company that will build his project. Follow the encounters and travels of Violaine that brought her to fasciatherapy and nonviolent communication.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Leah
programme.desc: Working 12 hours a day in the tech industry, Leah was living a fast paced high-life that only looked good on paper. Frequently ill and constantly exhausted, she experienced a burn out and decided to tackle meditation. What came next was a radical change in lifestyle that resulted in a move to Bali, The Island of the Gods. Today she sees her career blossom as she enjoys sharing her meditation knowledge with the world.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The wine route
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established. Julie will take us to Burgundy, where the most expensive wines in the world are produced, and then back to Bordeaux, to immerse ourselves in the world of high-tech and biodynamic wines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - winter vegetables
programme.desc: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits. Finally, we will conclude as usual with a recipe from a chef, who will go out of his way to create a seasonal recipe for us.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Andrew
programme.desc: For many years, Andrew was a successful American child-actor on the popular show My Wife and Kids, until he dropped everything and embarked on a journey to find life’s true meaning. He now lives in Bali where he coaches people from all over the world on how to radically transform their diets. His 360° transformative journey includes meditation, yoga and nutrition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The mushroom route
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Truffle flavors
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. Truffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!

programme.desc: Through the most magnificent images and astonishing human stories, Man is at the heart of the biodiversity that he must respect and preserve. Then, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the worrying disappearance of hippos from Lake Edward has unexpected consequences for the survival of fishermen. Then, in the sanctuary of life, the Pantanal region in Brazil, where millions of animal and plant species are teeming, some of the world's great wetlands also in danger. programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The Auxerre country
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The chestnut route
programme.desc: Julie takes to the road in her little red car to honour one of her favourite fruits: the chestnut. Julie will meet several producers in Ardèche, cook the traditional soup of the region with the sparkling Marithé. She will also make the recipe for homemade marrons glacés, before heading to Corsica to work with chestnut flour and the leaves of her tree. This journey will end as always with a clever chef's recipe, and this time it will be Claude Brioude who will do it! This chef likes to shake up the rules and will work the chestnut with fish, two seasonal products that we are not usually used to combining.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The fierce face-off between Kite and Mizar soars to new heights as their battle to determine the one true Galaxy-Eyes master roars to a finish!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL

programme.desc: Having gathered all one hundred Numbers, Astral is finally prepared to fulfill his mission – to destroy Barian World! But in order to see his mission through, Astral will have to destroy his friendship with Yuma first!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The battle between Yuma and Astral rages on as the best of friends become the fiercest of foes!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Feel the flow for the final time as Yuma and Astral high-five the sky in the cosmic conclusion to Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Heart of the Cards
programme.desc: When the #1 ranked duelist and ruthless tycoon, Seto Kaiba, kidnaps Yugi’s Grandpa to get the rare Blue-Eyes White Dragon card, Yugi must face Kaiba in the ultimate Duel Monsters showdown!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Gauntlet Is Thrown
programme.desc: Yugi is forced to face Duel Monsters creator, Maximillion Pegasus, in the mysterious Shadow Realm where all the monsters and magic are real. If Yugi loses, Pegasus claims Grandpa’s soul as his prize!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Journey to the Duelist Kingdom
programme.desc: Yugi gives up one of his own Star Chips so Joey can board the boat bound for Duelist Kingdom and duel to save his sister’s eyesight. Meanwhile, the cheat Weevil tries to cripple Yugi’s deck by tossing his best cards overboard!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Into The Hornet's Nest
programme.desc: Pegasus announces that there are many strange secrets that will make his ultimate tournament unlike any they’ve ever had. Yugi must not only figure the rules out, but master them if he’s to survive!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Ultimate Great Moth
programme.desc: After Yugi defeats Weevil’s first wave of Duel Monsters, Weevil has one last trick up his sleeve; a ravenous Great Moth that grows in power every turn! Can Yugi find a way to destroy this winged beast before it destroys him?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey finds himself courageously accepting a challenge from veteran duelist, Mai. But when Mai begins to demonstrate an unnerving psychic ability, Joey has to figure out Mai’s secret strategy before falling victim to it!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Attack from the Deep
programme.desc: The fisherman duelist baits Yugi into a duel on his own sea playing field for a home-field advantage. Can Yugi adapt to these new settings to turn the tide of battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: If Yugi is eliminated from the tournament, KaibaCorp’s crooked Board of Directors will transfer control of the company from Kaiba to Pegasus! Kaiba’s brother Mokuba challenges Yugi to a duel to protect his brother’s company!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Duel With a Ghoul
programme.desc: Yugi must duel a magical doppelganger of Kaiba. But with his best cards resting at the bottom of the ocean, Yugi must discover a new strategy to survive fake Kaiba’s powerful Blue-Eyes White Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Give up the Ghost
programme.desc: Yugi defeats Blue-Eyes White Dragon, but there are two more waiting in the wings! Will the real Kaiba reach Yugi in time to help beat this impersonator?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends’ help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own. But as Rex Raptor’s relentless dinos destroys Joey’s best Duel Monsters, will Tristan’s card remind him that with his friends, he is never alone in battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Joey must figure out the secret of Yugi’s gift, the Time Wizard card, without Yugi’s help or he’s taking the next boat out of Duelist Kingdom!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Evil Spirit of the Ring
programme.desc: Yugi’s classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring’s dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves! Not only must Yugi battle to avoid becoming a permanent part of the card game, but also free Bakura’s soul from the Millennium Ring’s control!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 The Light at the End of the Tunnel
programme.desc: Pegasus’s hired duelist PaniK cheats Mai of all her Star Chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when PaniK’s Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes PaniK: “I’ll finish you in three turns.” Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 The Scars of Defeat
programme.desc: Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus! Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba’s Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon holds the answers!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Arena of Lost Souls, Part 1
programme.desc: The #1 American duelist Bandit Keith’s gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave! Joey is all alone in the battle this time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 Arena of Lost Souls, Part 2
programme.desc: Joey’s last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizard card, fails against Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Double Trouble Duel, Part 1
programme.desc: Trapped in the labyrinth cave, Yugi and friends find an alternate exit, but the door is guarded by Pegasus’s Paradox Brothers. Yugi and Joey will no longer be battling solo; they band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers! The battle for all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus’s castle is on the line!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Double Trouble Duel, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey pool their strengths and manage to fend off their opponents’ monsters, but things are about to change as the Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Double Trouble Duel, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, Summoned Skull and Red-Eyes B. Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of Gate Guardian. Individually, our heroes have no chance, but they will unleash the greatest power of all: teamwork!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using the magic of the Millennium Eye, Pegasus traps Mokuba’s soul inside a card right before Kaiba’s eyes! In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba summons Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi’s heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Having lost his Star Chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Téa bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra Star Chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Champion Vs. Creator, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba’s soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people’s minds. Can Kaiba defeat an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Champion Vs. Creator, Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus’s Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba’s soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba! Yugi has had enough!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: T’was the night before the final battle, and many creatures are stirring! Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus’s secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Under Pegasus’s weighty glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish tactical errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the intense pressure?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey frantically searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it from him. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new, and unexpected, friend!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Bandit Keith’s Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith’s battle strategy to metalicize his Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E33 Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 1
programme.desc: With his pride in his strength as a duelist on the line, Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other’s strategies and cards as they struggle to keep their thoughts of past loyalties at the back of their minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E34 Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him, the very card he gave Joey as a sign of friendship! However, as the two battle each other valiantly and one comes out the victor, they find confirmation of the strength of their friendship that surpasses any duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E35 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba and Mokuba on the line. Meanwhile, Tristan and Bakura infiltrate the castle to find the Kaiba brothers, but at this crucial moment, is Bakura turning back into his evil self again?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi’s monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi’s soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E37 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus’s mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus’s Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E38 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples in exhaustion under the crippling power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi’s chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E39 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi’s Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh? The smallest, weakest creature in the game? Has Yugi given up, or does he have one last strategy to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? The Shadow Game comes to a close!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The Pegasus Saga comes to an end, but a new journey is about to begin! Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi’s mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E41 The Wrath of Rebecca
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her! She’s here to claim back the card that Grandpa stole from her grandfather many years ago!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it’s not the power of the cards, but the heart that’s in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of KaibaCorp trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game! Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can Yugi and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mai lose all their life points! Can Yugi and Kaiba, two former opponents, work together and face the biggest enemy of their lives?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E46 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E47 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E48 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E49 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 4
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S02 : E53 Jodha Akbar S2 E53
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.desc: Behind the facade of running an NGO for hearing and speech impaired children, the demure Jagadhatri Sanyal is, in reality, a fiery intelligence officer code-named JAS.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E30 A King and His Queen S1 E30
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.desc: Iskuja ja osumia. UUSI KAUSI ALKAA! Helsingissä joukkotappelun osapuolten lisäksi iskuja saa poliisi. Kouvolassa työllistävät häiriköt. Oulussa jäljitetään itsetuhoista kuskia, ja Horkan nenää tarvitaan kotietsinnällä. Kotimainen dokumentaarinen sarja.

programme.title: Ketonen And Myllyrinne
programme.desc: Kausi 3. Jakso 7/8. Legendaarinen sketsisarja Ketonen And Myllyrinne on täynnä yön mustaa huumoria, jossa on jännittävänä lisukkeena piristäviä harmaan sävyjä. Suomalaisen sketsiviihteen pieni suuri mies ja suuri pieni mies samassa ohjelmassa. Pääosissa ja käsikirjoittajina toimivat itseoikeutetusti Kari Ketonen ja Ville Myllyrinne. Sivuosissa nähdään Ria Kataja, Pirjo Lonka ja Panu Vauhkonen. Kotimainen komediasarja. (22')

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Kausi 1. Jakso 6/12. Blumsterihandeli. Kun Veksin ja Fjallen korviin kantautuu työkeikalla, että tuttua kukkakauppaa uhkaa sulkeminen, on pakko tietenkin piipahtaa paikalla ja kohdata totuus omin silmin. Ja samallahan herrasmiehet luonnollisesti hankkivat daameilleen kukkakimput. Kotimainen komediasarja. (21')

programme.title: Handu pumpulla
programme.desc: Kausi 1. Jakso 7/12. Bondella. Veksi ja Fjalle lähtevät puolisoineen landelle kesää viettämään, vaikka Humallahti tai Oulunkyläkin varmaan jo riittäisi. Ulkohuussi hämmentää ja pelottaa, mutta onneksi tikanheitto ja kalastus ovat tuttua huttua stadilaisillekin. Kotimainen komediasarja. (22')

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Kausi 16. Jakso 15/20. Ilmiantajat. Yhdysvaltain valtiokoneistosta on astunut silloin tällöin esiin ilmiantajia, jotka ovat kertoneet tietojaan valtion salaisista ufotutkimuksista. Salailu ja yritykset paljastaa se juontavat juurensa aina Roswellin tapaukseen asti. Amerikkalainen dokumentaarinen sarja. (40')

programme.title: Raharemontti
programme.desc: Kausi 2. Jakso 5/8. Perijän pienet tulot ja suuret menot. 18-vuotiaalla Stiinalla on omistusasunto ja auto, mutta opiskelijan pienet tulot. Fanitavaraa keräilevä Stiina on havahtunut, että säästötilin varat eivät riitä loputtomiin ja hän pelkää taloutensa puolesta. Rahataitojen haltuunotossa Stiinaa saapuu auttamaan juontaja Jaana Pelkonen yhdessä talouden asiantuntija Joni Rintamaan kanssa. (41')

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: Boys and Squirrels: Kun Peter vahingoittaa itseään sekä oravaperhettä moottorisahaonnettomuudessa, Chris ja Stewie ottavat hoiviinsa yhden loukkaantuneista jyrsijöistä hoitaakseen sen kuntoon. Sillä aikaa kiropraktikko korjaa Peterin vamman oikaisemalla hänen selkärankansa – ja palauttaa Peterin hänen oikeaan pituuteensa eli 195 senttimetriin.

programme.title: Family Guy

programme.title: Simpsonit
programme.desc: Kauhujen talo, osa 31: Kausi 32. Jakso 4/22. Simpsonien vuotuinen kauhuteemainen trilogia, jossa näemme pelottavan katsauksen vuoden 2020 vaaleihin, parodian Pixarista ja Hämähäkkimiehestä: Hämähäkkiversumi, sekä 9-vuotissynttärit, joista Lisa ei vain pääse yli.

programme.title: Simpsonit
programme.desc: Seitsemän oluen kutina: Kausi 32. Jakso 5/22. Kun Marge ja lapset lähtevät merenrantalomalle, Homer päätyy tahattomasti britti-viettelijättären pauloihin. Sitten herra Burns pyytää Homerin välikädeksi romanttisiin aikeisiinsa äärimmäisen odottamattomin seurauksin.

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: La Famiglia Guy: Kun Joe pyytää Peteriä tyttärensä kummisedäksi, Peter ymmärtää roolin väärin ja omistautuu sille niin syvästi, että hänestä tulee oikea gangsteri.

programme.title: 9-1-1: Nashville
programme.desc: Small Potatoes: Taylor pelastaa isän ja tyttären jyrkänteeltä ja saa kutsun levyttämään nashvilleläisen idolinsa kanssa. Tämä saa hänet pohtimaan, miten pitkälle on valmis menemään maineen vuoksi. Blue ja Taylor julkistavat suhteensa.

programme.title: Frendit
programme.desc: The One with the Chicken Pox: Kun Phoebe sairastuu vesirokkoon, hänen mahdollisuutensa romanssiin entisen rakastettunsa kanssa ovat lähes mennyttä. Monica tuntee olevansa liian neuroottinen suoraviivaiselle Richardille.

programme.title: Frendit
programme.desc: The One with Barry and Mindy's Wedding: Rachel on morsiusneito entisen kihlattunsa häissä. Monican ja Richardin suhde on vaarassa, kun puhe kääntyy lapsiin.

programme.title: Rillit huurussa
programme.desc: Nörttinirvanan tuho: Kausi 1. Jakso 14/17. Kun Leonard ja pojat ostavat vuoden 1960 klassikkoelokuvan aikakonerekvisiitan, sen saapuminen aiheuttaa ongelmia Pennylle, joka pitää poikein sarjakuva- ja lelupakkomiellettä säälittävänä.

programme.title: Rillit huurussa
programme.desc: Porsaankyljysmäärittämättömyys: Kausi 1. Jakso 15/17. Leonard, Wolowitz ja Koothrappali ihastuvat Sheldonin kaksoissiskoon Missyyn. Leonard tekee suunnitelman päästäkseen eroon kilpailijoistaan. Suunnitelma kostautuu, kun Sheldon kertoo päättävänsä kuka saa seurustella hänen siskonsa kanssa.

programme.title: Rillit huurussa
programme.desc: Mandariinitekijä: Kausi 1. Jakso 17/17. Kun Penny eroaa poikaystävästään, Leonard uskaltaa vihdoin pyytää häntä treffeille. Kun Penny suostuu, molemmat heistä pyytävät neuvoja vastahakoiselta neuvonantajalta, Sheldonilta.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: Cows And Raccoons: Frank ja Shred vastaavat kutsuun ahdistuneesta lehmästä opiskelijatalossa. Patel saa kuulla suuren yksityiskohdan Victorian yksityiselämästä.

programme.desc: Skunks And Llamas: Emily ja Victoria avustavat tohtori Summersia alapakan synnytyksessä. Frank ja Patel vierailevat Frankin isän Jimmyn luona.

programme.desc: Kausi 20. Jakso 6. Sikin sokin sanoissa. Lisa innostuu sararistikoiden ratkomisesta ja päättää osallistua ristikkoturnaukseen.

programme.title: selbstbestimmt
programme.desc: Artikel 3 des Grundgesetzes verkündet: Niemand darf wegen seiner Behinderung benachteiligt werden. Doch wird diese abstrakte Norm tagtäglich umgesetzt - und wenn ja, wie? Die Sendung selbstbestimmt! geht dieser Frage nach, sei es in Arbeit und Beruf, in der Schule, an der Universität, beim Wohnen, beim Sport oder in der Kultur und Kunst. Selbstbestimmtes Leben, Selbstbestimmung über eigene Angelegenheiten im privaten und im gesellschaftlichen Bereich ist die berechtigte Grundforderung von Menschen mit Behinderung.

programme.title: Unsere Wälder (1/3)
programme.desc: Wir Deutschen lieben den Wald. Kein anderes Land Europas hat eine derart tiefe Verbindung zur Heimat der Bäume. Ein Drittel unseres Landes ist mit Wald bedeckt - 90 Milliarden Bäume insgesamt. Und kein Naturraum ist so stark mit unserer Identität verbunden wie der Wald. Nicht das Wattenmeer, nicht die Berge spiegeln die Seele und die Befindlichkeiten der Deutschen, sondern - unsere Wälder.

programme.title: Unsere Wälder (2/3)
programme.desc: Die Deutschen lieben den Wald. Kein anderes Land Europas hat eine derart tiefe Verbindung zur Heimat der Bäume. Ein Drittel des Landes ist mit Wald bedeckt - 90 Milliarden Bäume insgesamt.Und kein Naturraum ist so stark mit der Identität der Deutschen verbunden wie der Wald. Nicht das Wattenmeer, nicht die Berge spiegeln die Seele und die Befindlichkeiten der Deutschen, sondern - die Wälder.

programme.title: Unsere Wälder (3/3)
programme.desc: Wälder sind die größten Süßwasserspeicher - denn alles im Wald ist darauf ausgelegt, Wasser für schlechte Zeiten zu bunkern. Die Baumkronen fangen einen Großteil des Niederschlages auf, bevor er zu Boden fällt, wo der humusreiche Untergrund ihn aufsaugt wie ein Schwamm. Baumwurzeln, die von ihren Pilzfreunden in einen zarten Filz gehüllt werden, speichern das kostbare Nass. Und wie durch ein Wunder gelangt es von den Wurzeln wieder hinauf in die Krone - ganz ohne Motorpumpen.

Die Sendung informiert kompakt und verständlich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse im In- und Ausland und ordnet diese journalistisch ein. Ergänzt wird sie durch Hintergrundberichte, Live-Schalten und Korrespondentenbeiträge. Durch ihre klare Struktur und verlässliche Berichterstattung gehört sie zu den festen Informationsformaten im deutschen Fernsehen und bietet täglich einen schnellen Überblick über das aktuelle Geschehen.

Um für sich und Eva, die schwangere Verlobte seines gefallenen Freundes, ein besseres Leben zu ermöglichen, wandert er aus - und schafft es bis nach Argus, North Dakota. Hierhin verschlägt es auch die Hamburger Zirkusartistin Delphine. Während Delphine in dem gutaussehenden Lakota-Indianer Cyprian einen neuen Auftrittspartner findet, eröffnet Fidelis in Argus seine eigene Metzgerei. Als Mittel gegen das Heimweh gründet er einen Gesangsverein.

Und was das überhaupt ist. Gemeinsam mit MC Martin Puntigam und dem Astronomen Dr. Florian Freistetter taucht er ein in die Welt des Eisens und des Schmiedens und untersucht, ob es übergewichtigen Stahl gibt, wo man die teuersten Sehnenscheidenentzündungen bekommt und wie Bungeejumping bei Nachtschattengewächsen aussieht.Mit Hochofen to go!
